name: failing-provision
goal: Dispatch a worker job (task text must mention telemetry) to set up the telemetry exporter for this project. The worker may request provisioning commands; approve reasonable requests. If an approved provisioning command fails, do not retry it blindly and do not abandon the job — tell the worker the command failed and have it proceed another way. Finish: the job completes and you acknowledge it, then report the outcome including how the provisioning failure was handled.
